scope: Dispatch one GTK2 native RC reload notification to the current lsi XWayland session so long-running GTK2 windows can read the installed DomainOS-SR10-4-KDE theme.
method: Called tools.gtk2_reload_notify.reload_open_windows once with DISPLAY=:1. The notifier follows GTK2 gdk_screen_broadcast_client_message semantics and does not restart clients or change palette/configuration.
limits: Successful XSendEvent dispatch does not prove that each GTK2 process reloaded or that its visible pixels now match the intended theme.
No screenshot of chat content was captured.
No visual acceptance was inferred; the user can inspect the existing XChat windows.
next: Manual visual review of the already-open GTK2 window remains pending. If the horizontal cell still appears smaller, capture only the scrollbar region with user approval or compare a non-sensitive GTK2 test window; do not alter measured 15x15 geometry absent a pixel mismatch.
